cherokee: ᎩᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎡᎯ, ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒᏉ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎦ, ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᏟᏗᏱ ᎠᏁᎯ ᎠᏂᏰᎪᎩ ᎨᏐ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᏲ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᎯ, ᏧᏍᎦᏃᎸ ᏧᏂᏍᏉᎵᏱ.
english: One of themselves, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, idle gluttons.

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᏪᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎤᎪᎯᏳᎭ. ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏍᏓᏯ ᏕᎯᎬᏍ\ᎸᏅᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎪᎸ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒᎢ;
english: This testimony is true. For which cause reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

cherokee: ᏄᎾᎦᏌᏯᏍᏛᎾᏉ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎠᏂᏧᏏ ᎤᏁᏃᎮᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫᏉ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏂᎪᎸᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏁᏨᎯ.
english: not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎬᏩᏁᏲᏗ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏂᏫᎾᎨᏌᏂ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᎤᎾᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᏧᏂᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏰᎯ, ᏧᏂᎨᏳᎯ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏧᏁᏥ,
english: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,

cherokee: ᎩᎶ ᎤᏐᏅ ᎤᏂᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᏧᎾᏘᏲᏌᏘ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏍᎩᏂ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏂᎥᏉ ᎠᏂᎦᏔᎲ ᎤᏣᏘ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: to speak evil of no man, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all meekness toward all men.

cherokee: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎿᏉ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎢᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏴᏫ ᏚᎨᏳᏒ ᎤᎦᏄᎪᏨ,
english: But when the kindness of God our Saviour, and his love toward man, appeared,

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎦᏚᏓᎴᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎢᎦᏤᎵ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎢᎬᏒᎢ.
english: that, being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

cherokee: ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎪᎸᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᏓᏓᏚᎪᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
english: knowing that such a one is perverted, and sinneth, being self-condemned.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᏤᎵᎦ ᏩᎾᏕᎶᏆ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏍᏛ ᏧᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏚᎸᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎬᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏁᏉᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
english: And let our people also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᎾᏰᏍᎬ ᏥᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏓᏅᏅ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ ᏧᎾᏓᏲᏒᎯ ᏥᎨᏒ ᏕᎨᏥᎾᏝᎥᎢ.
english: and might deliver all them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏓᏍᏔᏅᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᏤᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎼᏏ ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᏥᎨᏎ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᏓᏘᎾᎥᎢ.
english: who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.

cherokee: ᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏗᏥᏍᏓᏲᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᏥᎾᏫ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ ᏥᎬᎩᎾᎸᏍᏔᏅᎩ, ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᎦ ᏥᎬᎩᎪᎵᏰᎥᎩ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ;
english: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, Like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

cherokee: ᎾᎯᏳ ᏗᏥᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᏥᎬᎩᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎬᏆᎦᏘᏍᎬᎩ, ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏘᏍᎬᎩᏍᎩᎢᏃᏅ ᏓᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎥᎦᏍᎪᎯ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ.
english: Where your fathers tried me by proving me, And saw my works forty years.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏓᏳᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᏆᏎᎵᏔᏅᎩ ᎠᎩᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏴᏍᏗᏳ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: As I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᎢᏗᎪᏩᏘᎭ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎬᏩᏂᎬᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏄᏃᎯᏅᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: And we see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᏴᎬᏂᏴᎭ ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᎠᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
english: and in this place again, They shall not enter into my rest.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᏏᏉ ᎤᏁᏘᏰᎭ ᎤᎾᏣᏪᏐᎸᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ ᏴᏫ.
english: There remaineth therefore a sabbath rest for the people of God.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏓᏟᏂᎬᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎾᎩᏴᏍᏗᏱ, ᏱᏅᏎᎦᎩᏰᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏕᎶᏆᎡᎸᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏄᏬᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏴᎦᏅᎢᏍᏓ.
english: Let us therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, that no man fall after the same example of disobedience.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᏄᎬᏫᏳᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᏬᏎᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ.
english: named of God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

cherokee: ᏗᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏗᏕᏲᏅᎯ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏏᏔᏗᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᏧᎾᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ.
english: of the teaching of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᏓᏛᏁᎵ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎸ.
english: And this will we do, if God permit.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏁᎶᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎩ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
english: and tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the age to come,

cherokee: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏰᏃ ᎡᏆᎭᎻ ᎤᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎶ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᏒᎲ ᎬᏩᏎᎵᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎤᏩᏒ ᎡᎲ ᎤᏎᎵᏙᏔᏁᎢ,
english: For when God made promise to Abraham, since he could swear by none greater, he sware by himself,

cherokee: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎪᎯᏗᏳ ᎤᎦᏘᏛ ᎠᏥᏁᎴ ᎠᏚᎢᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: And thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎡᏍᎦ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎤᏁᏤᎰ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏯᏥᎸᏉᏗ.
english: But without any dispute the less is blessed of the better.

cherokee: ᎠᏏᏉᏰᏃ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᏰᎸ ᎠᏯᎡᎢ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎹᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏥᏚᏠᏍᎨᎢ.
english: for he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchizedek met him.

cherokee: ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏰᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏁᏟᏴᏛ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
english: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏏ ᎤᏟ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎺᎵᎩᏏᏕᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎶᎯ ᏱᎦᎾᏄᎪᎦ,
english: And what we say is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there ariseth another priest,

cherokee: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏰᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎢᎬᏁᎸᎯ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎤᎵᏁᏨᎯ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎠᏩᏂᎦᎳᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎬᏩᏓᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
english: For there is a disannulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and unprofitableness

cherokee: ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᏗᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎵᏦᏔᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏴᏫ.
english: a minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, not man.

cherokee: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎦᎫᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏗᏠᎯᏍᏙᏗᏱ ᏱᎬᏩᏂᏔᏲᎴᎢ.
english: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then would no place have been sought for a second.

cherokee: ᏓᎦᏥᏯᏙᎵᏥᏰᏃ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸᎢ, ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏆᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
english: For I will be merciful to their iniquities, And their sins will I remember no more.

cherokee: ᎠᎴᏬ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏕᎪᏢᏒᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎤᎬᏩᎵ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎡᎯ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ.
english: Now even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service, and its sanctuary, a sanctuary of this world.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏔᏍᏗᏱᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎪᏑᎴᏗᏱ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᎨᏒ ᏧᎬᏩᎴᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏥᏂᎨᎬᏁᎴ ᎤᏓᏁᏟᏴᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎵᏰᎢᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
english: being only (with meats and drinks and divers washings) carnal ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

cherokee: ᎧᏃᎮᏛᏰᏃ ᏗᏠᎯᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᏎ ᎠᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏐ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛᎢ.
english: For where a testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him that made it.

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᏂᏪᏍᎨᎢ, ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎩᎬ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᏓᏠᎯᏍᏛ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏗᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏥᏥᏁᏤ ᏗᏥᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗᏱ.
english: saying, This is the blood of the covenant which God commanded to you-ward.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎩᎬ ᏚᏍᏚᏟᏍᏔᏁ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏔᏂᏓᏍᏗ ᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
english: Moreover the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry he sprinkled in like manner with the blood.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩᏍᎩᏂ Ꮎ ᏓᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏗᏍᎬᎢ, ᏂᏓᏕᏘᏴᎯᏒ ᎤᎾᏅᏓᏗᏏᏐᏗᏉ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ.
english: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance made of sins year by year.

cherokee: ᎥᏝᏰᏃ ᏩᎦ ᏧᎾᎪᏅᏍᏓᎵ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏫ ᏗᏂᎭᏄᎸᎯ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᏰᎵ ᎬᏩᏂᎲᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎦᏘᏯ ᎬᏂ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎩ ᏧᎳᏏᏗᏱ ᎦᏍᎩᎶ ᏂᎨᎬᏁᎸᎭ.
english: henceforth expecting till his enemies be made the footstool of his feet.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎵᏙᎸ ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏆᏅᏓᏗᏍᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ.
english: And their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᏨᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏴᏓᏗᏁᎸᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎥᏝ ᎿᏉ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᎠᎫᏴᏙᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᏱᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ.
english: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

cherokee: ᎤᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎣᏓᏅᏛ ᎠᎦᏖᎾᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎫᎪᏙᏗ ᎢᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏥᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏂᏛᏙᏗ ᏥᎩ ᎬᏩᏍᎦᎩ.
english: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which shall devour the adversaries.
It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

cherokee: ᎿᏉᏰᏃ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾᏉ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏓᎦᎷᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏴᏛᏙᎯᏗ.
english: For yet a very little while, He that cometh shall come, and shall not tarry.

cherokee: ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏗ ᎦᏛᎬᎢ, ᎤᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ ᎠᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱ ᎨᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎣᏩᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏄᏜᏏᏛᏒᎾ ᎢᏳᏓᎵᏍᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᎡᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᏏ ᎠᎪᎲᎯ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, a conviction of things not seen.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎡᏘ ᎤᎾᏕᏅᎯ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏗᏱ ᎤᏂᏩᏛᎲᎩ.
english: For therein the elders had witness borne to them.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎢᏯᏂᏪᏍᎩ, ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢᏳ ᎾᏅᏁᎰ ᎤᎾᏤᎵᎪᎯ ᎤᏂᏲᎲᎢ.
english: For they that say such things make it manifest that they are seeking after a country of their own.

cherokee: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏳᎾᏅᏖ ᎾᎿ ᏧᏂᏄᎪᏨᎢ ᏳᎾᏜᏅᏓᎴᏉ ᎥᎤᎾᏨᏍᏗᏱ;
english: And if indeed they had been mindful of that country from which they went out, they would have had opportunity to return.

cherokee: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᏓᏐᏴ ᏤᎵᎪ ᏚᏪᏒᏙᎠᏎᎢ, ᎿᏉ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏧᏒᎯᏛ ᏂᏚᎾᏚᏫᏍᏔᏁᎢ.
english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been compassed about for seven days.

cherokee: ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎬᏗᏍᎬ ᎴᎭᏫ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏛ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏥᏛᏔᏁ ᎨᏥᏛᏔᏅ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏄᏃᎯᏳᏒᎾ ᏥᎨ-ᏎᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏙᎯᏱ ᏥᏚᏓᏂᎸᏤ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎦᏛᏂᏙᎯ.
english: By faith Rahab the harlot perished not with them that were disobedient, having received the spies with peace.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏅᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᏰᎵ ᏕᎪᏢᏒ ᏥᏓᎾᏓᎵᏁᎯᏕᎮᎢ, ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏥᏚᏂᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎮᎢ, ᎤᎾᏤᎵ ᏥᎾᏅᏁᎮ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᎸᎢ, ᏢᏓᏥ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᏅ ᏗᏂᎰᎵ ᏥᏓᏂᏍᏚᎲᏍᎨᎢ,
english: who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᏥᎨᏎ ᎤᏃᎯᏳᏒ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ, ᎥᏝ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏥᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏱᏚᏁᏓᏂᎸᏤᎢ;
english: And these all, having had witness borne to them through their faith, received not the promise,

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎤᎨᏳᎯ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏕᎦᎵᎥᏂᎰ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏓᏂᎸᏨᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, And scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
for our God is a consuming fire.

cherokee: ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᏅᏩᏍᏗᏉ ᎤᏒᎯ ᏥᏄᏍᏛ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎢᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and to-day, yea and for ever.

cherokee: ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎢᎪᏢᎭ, ᎾᎿ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏚᏳᎪᏗ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗᏱ ᎦᎵᏦᏛᏉ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᎾᏛᏁᎯ ᏥᎩ.
english: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat that serve the tabernacle.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏕᎾ ᏪᏗᎷᏥ ᎦᎵᏦᏛ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ, ᎢᎦᏠᏯᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏰᏥᏐᏢᏗᏍᎬᎢ;
english: For we have not here an abiding city, but we seek after the city which is to come.

cherokee: ᎯᎠᏍᎩᏂᏃᏅ ᎢᏣᏛᏁᏗᏱ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᏨᏍᏗᏰᏗᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏞᎦᎾᎨ ᏗᏤᎲ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏮᏆᏘᏃᎯᏍᏗᏱ.
english: And I exhort you the more exceedingly to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

cherokee: ᏕᏥᏲᎵᎸᎭ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎨᏣᎦᏌᏯᏍᏗᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ. ᎢᏓᎵ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏫᎨᏥᏲᎵᎦ.
english: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

cherokee: ᎬᏩᎦᏘᏯ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏕᏥᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᏥᎥᎢ. ᎡᎺᏅ.
english: Grace be with you all. Amen.

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎦᏔᎮᏍᏗ, ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᎠᎪᎵᎡᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏨᏂᏗᏳ ᏂᏨᏁᎲᎢ.
english: knowing that the proving of your faith worketh patience.

cherokee: ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᏔᎵ ᎢᏳᏓᎢ ᎤᏓᏅᏛᎢ ᎤᏁᏟᏴᏌᏘ ᎨᏐᎢ ᏂᎦᎥ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
english: a doubleminded man, unstable in all his ways.

cherokee: ᎩᎶᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏥᎪᎵᏰᏍᎪᎢ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᏧᏘᏁᎯ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏌᏛᎥᏍᎪᎢ.
english: but each man is tempted, when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.

cherokee: ᏴᏫᏰᏃ ᎤᏔᎳᏬᏍᎬᎢ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎦᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᎪ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
english: for the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏨᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎢᏨᏔᏅᎭ ᏕᏣᏓᏂᎸᏨᎭ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎬᏱᏝᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎬᏩᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᏥᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙᎩ.
english: Wherefore putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with meekness the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

cherokee: ᎤᏩᏒᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᎪᏩᏘᏍᎪᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᏅᏍᎪᎢ, ᎩᎳᏉᏃ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎤᏩᎨᏫᏍᎪ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ.
english: for he beholdeth himself, and goeth away, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.

cherokee: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᏱᏓᎧᎿᏩᏕᎦ, ᏑᏓᎴᎩᏉᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏯᏲᏍᏗᎭ, ᏂᎦᏛ ᏚᏲᏍᏔᏃᎢ.
english: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet stumble in one point, he is become guilty of all.

cherokee: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎢᎩᏅᏟ ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏙ ᏧᏂᏰᎸᎭ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏳᏂᏂᎬᎦ ᏂᏚᎩᏨᏂᏒ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
english: If a brother or sister be naked and in lack of daily food,

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏛᏛᎾ ᎢᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ, ᎤᏩᏒᏉ ᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
english: Even so faith, if it have not works, is dead in itself.

cherokee: ᎠᏰᎸᏰᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ ᏄᏪᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎤᏓᏬᏨᎯ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯᏉ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᏄᏛᏛᎾ ᏱᎩ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎵᏬᏨᎯ ᎨᏐᎢ.
english: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

cherokee: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᏕᏗᎭᎾᎳᏗᏍᎪ ᏐᏈᎵ ᎨᎪᎯᏳᏗᏱ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬ ᏗᏂᏰᎸ ᏕᏗᎪᎸᏏᏙᎰᎢ.
english: Now if we put the horses’ bridles into their mouths that they may obey us, we turn about their whole body also.

cherokee: ᎦᎪ ᏂᎯ ᏂᏣᏛᏅᎢ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᏂᎢ? ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᎦᎾᏄᎪᏩ ᏕᎤᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ ᏫᎬᏙᏓ ᎣᏏᏳ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏫᎬᏙᏓ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏔᎵ ᎤᏛᏕᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: Who is wise and understanding among you? let him show by his good life his works in meekness of wisdom.

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏏᎾᏌᏂᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎥᏝ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏅᏓᏳᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎡᎶᎯᏉᏍᎩᏂ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏊᏓᎸᏉ ᎡᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ.
english: This wisdom is not a wisdom that cometh down from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.

cherokee: ᎾᎿᏰᏃ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏗᏒᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ, ᎾᎿ ᎡᎰ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: For where jealousy and faction are, there is confusion and every vile deed.

cherokee: ᎠᏃᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩᏂ ᎠᏃᎯᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏂᏫᏍᎪ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎤᎾᏄᎪᏫᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace for them that make peace.

cherokee: ᎢᏣᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏙᏗᎧᏂᏍᎬᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏓᏥᏌᎳᏓᏂ.
english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall exalt you.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᎶ ᏣᎦᏔᎰᎢ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎢᏯᏛᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎾᏛᏁᎲᎾ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᎿ ᎠᏍᎦᏅᎪᎢ.
english: To him therefore that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.

cherokee: ᏧᎬᏩᎶᏗ ᎢᏥᎲᎢ ᎤᎪᏒ; ᏗᏣᏄᏬᏃ ᏥᏍᎪᏴ ᎦᏂᏯᎥ;
english: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are moth-eaten.

cherokee: ᎩᎶ ᎢᏤᎲ ᎤᏓᏑᏰᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎨᏍᏗ, ᎠᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ; ᎩᎶ ᎤᎦᎵᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᏍᏗ ᏕᎧᏃᎩᏍᎨᏍᏗ.
english: Is any among you suffering? let him pray. Is any cheerful? let him sing praise.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎡᏣᎵᏍᎪᎸᏓᏁᎭ ᎢᏦᎯᏳᏒ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎤᎬᏩᎸᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏗᏍᏕᎸᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎾᏥᎦᏔᎰᎢ ᎠᏏ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎾᏙᏢᏍᎬᎾ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎾᎬᏁᎴ ᎪᎯ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᏕᎨᏌᏗᏒᎢ ᏂᎯ ᎢᏣᎵᏍᏕᎸᏙᏗ,
english: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was manifested at the end of the times for your sake,

cherokee: ᏔᎵᏁ ᎢᏣᏕᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᏲᎩ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎢᏣᏕᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏲᎩᏍᎩᏂ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎧᏃᎥᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏟᎵ ᎢᏳᏩᏂᏌᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏃᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎡᎯ ᏥᎩ.
english: having been begotten again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which liveth and abideth.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎢᏴᏛ ᏂᏨᎦ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎦᎶᏄᎮᏛ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏠᎾᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏛᏳᎨᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏄᏓᎴᏒ ᎤᏲ ᏗᏓᏃᎮᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ,
english: Putting away therefore all wickedness, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏂᏗᎨᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎢᏳᏍᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎥᏝᏍᏗ ᎠᏗᎾ ᏂᏕᏥᎾᏝᎥᎾ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏨᏗᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᏱᏧᏢᎥᏍᎨᏍᏗ ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏅᏏᏓᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᏂᏣᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ.
english: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎬᏂᏗᏳ ᏱᎩ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎬᎢ, ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎠᏥᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
english: For this is acceptable, if for conscience toward God a man endureth griefs, suffering wrongfully.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᏩᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏲ ᏄᏓᏑᏴᎾ ᎢᏣᎴᏂᏙᎲ ᎤᎵᏠᏯᏍᏛ ᎦᎾᏰᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: beholding your chaste behavior coupled with fear.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏔᎲ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎬᏩᎴᎢ ᏧᎵᏁᏃᏗ ᏧᏭᎪᏓᏁᏗᏱ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ.
english: who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the living and the dead.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎤᏪᎵᎯᏍᏗ ᎢᏤᎲ ᏤᏥᏲᎯᏏ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᎢᏣᏓᏅᏖᏍᎪᎢ.
english: casting all your anxiety upon him, because he careth for you.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ. ᎡᎺᏅ.
english: To him be the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

cherokee: ᏄᏪᎲᎾᏍᎩᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎨᏫᏉ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏴᏛ ᎬᏩᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏩᎨᏫᏒᎯ ᎠᏥᏅᎦᎸᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎤᏍᎦᏅᏥᏙᎸᎢ.
english: For he that lacketh these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

cherokee: ᎢᎬᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᎦᏙᎥᏎᏍᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏌᏉ ᎤᏅ ᎠᏙᎴᎰᏒᎯ ᎪᏪᎸᎢ ᎤᏩᏒ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎬᏁᏢᏙᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: knowing this first, that no prophecy of scripture is of private interpretation.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎶᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᏧᏭᏓᎴᏎᎢ, ᎤᏕᏯᏔᏁᎸ ᏄᎾᎵᏏᎾᎯᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎠᏂᏍᏚᎾᎢ.
english: and delivered righteous Lot, sore distressed by the lascivious life of the wicked

cherokee: ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏍᎩᏂ ᎤᏟ ᎢᏧᎾᎵᏂᎩᏛ ᏥᎩ ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏐᏅ ᏱᏓᏂᎳᏫᏎᎰ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎠᎦᏔᎲᎢ.
english: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, bring not a railing judgment against them before the Lord.

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᏄᏍᏕᏍᏗ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᏣᏅᏖᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏅᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏂᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ,
english: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers shall come with mockery, walking after their own lusts,

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏨᏲᏪᎳᏁᎭ ᎢᏣᎵᎮᎵᎬ ᎤᎧᎵᎢᏍᏗᏱ.
english: and these things we write, that our joy may be made full.

cherokee: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎥᏝ ᎠᏍᎦᏂ ᏲᎨᎭ ᏱᏓᏗᎭ, ᎢᎬᏒ ᏱᏓᏓᎵᏓᏍᏗᎭ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎨᎭ ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

cherokee: ᎢᏳᏃ ᏱᏗᏃᎲᏍᎦ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᏄᏓᎵᏓᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏘᏳ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏁᏗᏱ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎩᏅᎦᎸᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎤᏲ ᏗᎦᎸᏫᏍᏓᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

cherokee: ᎢᏳᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏲᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏱᏓᏗᎭ, ᎡᏗᏰᎪᎥᏍᎦᏉ, ᎠᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᎥᏝ ᏱᎨᎨᎭ.
english: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

cherokee: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᎭ ᎡᏗᎦᏔᎲᎢ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏗᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ.
english: And hereby we know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

cherokee: ᎩᎶ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ ᏳᎨᏳᎭ ᎢᎦᎦᏛ ᎡᎭ, ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎠᏓᏙᏕᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏳᏪᎭ.
english: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is no occasion of stumbling in him.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎩᏚᎢᏍᏓᏁᎸᎯ ᏥᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᎩ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ.
english: And this is the promise which he promised us, even the life eternal.

cherokee: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ ᎢᎩᏍᎦᏅᏨ ᏱᏗᎫᎪᏗᎭ, ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏟ ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎡᏍᎦᏉ ᏗᎩᎾᏫ, ᎠᎴ ᎠᎦᏔᎯᏳ ᏂᎦᎥᎢ.
english: because if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

cherokee: ᎢᏨᎨᏳᎢ, ᎢᏳᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏔᏅᎯ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏗᎦᏓᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏱᎩ.
english: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

cherokee: ᎡᏗᎨᏳᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎬᏱ ᎢᎩᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏅᎢ.
english: We love, because he first loved us.

cherokee: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎢᎩᏁᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ, ᎾᏍᏉ ᎤᎨᏳᎯᏳ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᏗᎾᏓᏅᏟ.
english: And this commandment have we from him, that he who loveth God love his brother also.

cherokee: ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᏗᎨᏳᎢ ᏥᎨᏐᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᎩᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏓᏙᎴᎰᎯᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎨᏗᎨᏳᎢᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏪᏥ.
english: Hereby we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and do his commandments.

cherokee: ᎠᏂᏦᎢᏰᏃ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ; ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ, ᎧᏃᎮᏛ, ᎦᎸᏉᏗᏳᏃ ᎠᏓᏅᏙ; ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏦᎢ ᎨᏒ ᏌᏉᏉ.
english: And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is the truth.

cherokee: ᎢᏗᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏅᏓᎦᏓᎴᏅᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏃᏴᏨ ᎤᏲ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in the evil one.
My little children, guard yourselves from idols.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ Ꮎ ᎠᏲᎵᎯ ᎤᏪᎳᏗᏍᏗᎭ ᎤᏲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲᎢ.
english: for he that giveth him greeting partaketh in his evil works.

cherokee: ᎥᏝ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᏟ ᎢᎦᎢ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᏍᎩᏯ ᏱᎩ ᏂᎦᎥ ᎠᏆᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗᎬ ᎦᏛᎬᎦ ᏗᏇᏥ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒ ᎠᏁᏙᎲᎢ.
english: Greater joy have I none than this, to hear of my children walking in the truth.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏚᏙᎥ ᏅᏧᎵᏍᏙᏔᏅ ᎠᏁᏙᎭ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏂᏓᏂᏂᏟᏍᎬᎾ ᏧᎾᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏴᏫ.
english: because that for the sake of the Name they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᎭ ᏱᏗᏓᏓᏂᎸᎦ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏧᎳᎭ ᏕᎩᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏱᏗᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: We therefore ought to welcome such, that we may be fellow-workers for the truth.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎾᏍᎩᏓᏒᎥᏍᎩ ᎦᏓᎭ ᎾᏅᏁᎭ ᎤᏂᏇᏓᎸᎢ, ᏗᏂᏍᎦᎩ ᏄᏂᎬᏫᏳᏌᏕᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᎬᏩᏂᏐᏢᏗ ᎨᏥᎸᏉᏗ.
english: Yet in like manner these also in their dreamings defile the flesh, and set at nought dominion, and rail at dignities.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏂᏪᏒᎩ, ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎮᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏐᏢᎢᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏅᏒ ᎤᎾᏚᎸᏅᎥᏍᎬ ᏂᏚᏳᎪᏛᎾ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ.
english: that they said to you, In the last time there shall be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎠᎾᏓᏓᎴᏗᏍᎩ ᏥᎩ, ᎤᏇᏓᎵᏉ ᎠᏂᏍᏓᏩᏕᎩ, ᎠᎠᏅᏙ ᏄᏁᎲᎾ.
english: These are they who make separations, sensual, having not the Spirit.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏧᏃᎮᎴ ᎧᏃᎮᏛ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᏥᏌ ᎦᎶᏁᏛ ᎤᏃᎮᎸᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᎤᎪᎲᎢ.
english: who bare witness of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, even of all things that he saw.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏓᏥᏁᎵ ᏑᎾᎴ ᎡᎯᏃᏈᏏ.
english: and I will give him the morning star.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩᏃ Ꮎ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏁᏒᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎦᏘᏏᏗᏢ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎤᏒᎦᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᎤᏬᎵ.
english: And he came, and he taketh it out of the right hand of him that sat on the throne.

cherokee: ᏅᎩᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏅᏃᏛ ᎡᎺᏅ ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ ᎡᎳᏗ ᏚᎾᏓᏅᏅᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎡᎯ.
english: And the four living creatures said, Amen. And the elders fell down and worshipped.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏍᏚᎲ ᎤᏍᏚᎢᏒ, ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏒᎩ, ᎡᎭᎦᏔᏄᎦ.
english: And when he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, Come.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᏅᎩᏁ ᎠᏍᏚᎲ ᎤᏍᏚᎢᏒ, ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᎧᏁᎬ ᏅᎩᎬ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᎬᏃᏛ ᎯᎠ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬᎢ, ᎡᎭᎦᏔᏄᎦ.
english: And when he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, Come.

cherokee: ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁᏃ ᎠᏍᏚᎲ ᎤᏍᏚᎢᏒ ᎡᎳᏪ ᎤᏅᏅᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏛ ᎢᎪᎯᏛ.
english: And when he opened the seventh seal, there followed a silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏜ ᎦᏩᏒᎩ ᏚᎦᏒᏍᏛ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎠᎵᏌᎳᏗᏍᎬᎩ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ ᎠᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏓᎵᏌᎳᏗᏍᎬ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏛᏅ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏫᎦᎷᎬᎩ, ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᎠᏓᎴᎲᏍᎬᎩ.
english: And the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎦᎵᏉᎩ ᏗᏤᎷᎩ ᏗᏂᏁᎯ ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎢᏍᏔᏅᎩ ᏧᏂᏃᏴᎵᏍᏙᏗᏱ.
english: And the seven angels that had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᏍᏗᏰᎬᎩ ᎠᏂᎨᏴ ᏥᏚᏂᏍᏗᏰᎦ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᏄᏙᎬ ᏢᏓᏥ ᎤᏂᏃᏕᎾ ᏥᏓᏂᏄᏙᎦ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎨᏒᎩ.
english: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.

cherokee: ᏑᏓᎵᏁᏃ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏤᎷᎯᏒᎩ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎧᏁᎬ ᎠᏆᏛᎦᏅᎩ ᏛᏓᎴᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᏅᎩ ᏂᏕᎤᎷᎬ ᎠᏕᎸᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᎪᏢᏔᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᎸ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏛᏅ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏥᎦᎧᎭ,
english: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏥᏪᏎᎲᎩ ᏑᏓᎵᏁ ᎨᏒ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎠᏤᎷᎩ ᎦᏁᎯ, ᏔᎸᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮎ ᏅᎩ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎤᏔᏅ ᎡᏉᏂ ᎤᏪᏴ ᎷᏇ Ꮧ ᏥᏕᎨᎦᎸᎥ.
english: one saying to the sixth angel that had the trumpet, Loose the four angels that are bound at the great river Euphrates.

cherokee: ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᏳᏂᏰᎸᏅ ᏚᎾᏓᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᎾᏙᏅᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎵᏛ ᏚᎾᏂᏏᏂᏙᎸᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᏂᏃᏍᎩᏒᎢ.
english: and they repented not of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

cherokee: ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏗᏙᎯᏃ ᏥᎪᎥᎯ ᎠᎺᏉᎯ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏧᏔᏏᏅᎯ, ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎤᏌᎳᏓᏅᎩ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ,
english: And the angel that I saw standing upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his right hand to heaven,

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎣᎵᏩ ᏔᎵ ᏕᏡᎬᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵ ᏗᏨᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᎦᎪᏙᏗᏱ ᏥᏕᎦᎧᎭ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏬᏢᏅᎯ ᏄᏛᏅ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ.
english: These are the two olive trees and the two candlesticks, standing before the Lord of the earth.

cherokee: ᏅᎩᏦᏁᏃ ᎢᏯᏂᏛ ᏧᎾᏛᏐᏅᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏄᏛᏅ ᎢᎬᏱᏗᏢ ᏕᎦᏍᎩᎸ ᏣᏂᏅᎩ, ᏚᎾᎵᏯᏍᏚᏅᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏙᎵᏍᏓᏁᎸᎩ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ,
english: And the four and twenty elders, who sit before God on their thrones, fell upon their faces and worshipped God,

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᏳᎾᏓᏎᎪᎩᏎᎢ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎿᏉ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏳᏂᏩᏛᎮ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎤᎾᏕᏗᏱ.
english: and they prevailed not, neither was their place found any more in heaven.

cherokee: ᎠᏂ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᎭ ᏗᏅᏂᏗᏳ ᎨᏒ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ; ᎠᏁ ᎠᏁᎭ ᏗᏂᏍᏆᏂᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᏛᏍᏗ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᏧᏤᎵᎦ, ᎠᎴ ᎪᎯᏳᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏥᏌ ᎤᏤᎵᎦ.
english: Here is the patience of the saints, they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᏅᏩᏓᎴ ᏗᎧᎿᏩᎯᏙᎯ ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏨᏗᏓᏁᎸ ᏓᏳᏄᎪᏨᎩ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᏉ ᎦᏁᎲᎩ ᎪᏍᏓᏯ ᎠᏍᎫᏕᏍᏗ.
english: And another angel came out from the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᏚᏪᎧᏩᏗᏒ ᎤᎾᎵᏒᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏙᏓᎸ ᎥᏝ ᏗᎬᏩᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
english: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏥᏩᏛᎡᎸᎩ ᎤᏂᎩᎬ ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᏗ, ᎠᎴ ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘ, ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎡᎶᎯ ᏗᎨᏥᎸᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: And in her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all that have been slain upon the earth.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏱᎰᏩ ᎡᏗᎸᏉᏓ ᎤᎾᏛᏅᎩ. ᎠᎴ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏤᎵ ᏧᎦᏒᏍᏗ ᏓᎴᎲᏍᎬᎩ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎢ.
english: And a second time they say, Hallelujah. And her smoke goeth up for ever and ever.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎠᏁᎲ ᎬᏩᏍᏓᏩᏛᏒᎩ ᎤᏂᏁᎬ ᏐᏈᎵ ᏧᎾᎩᎸᏗ, ᏧᏏᏙᎵ ᏙᎴᏛ ᏗᏄᏬ ᏚᎾᏄᏬᏍᏛᎩ, ᏧᏁᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏓᎭ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
english: And the armies which are in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and pure.

cherokee: ᎠᏂᏐᎢᏍᎩᏂ ᏧᏂᏲᎱᏒᎯ ᎥᏝ ᏯᏁᎮ ᎬᏂ ᏌᏉ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᏚᎶᏐᏅ. ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᏗᎴᎯᏐᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: The rest of the dead lived not until the thousand years should be finished. This is the first resurrection.

cherokee: ᏌᏉᏃ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᎢᏧᏕᏘᏴᏛ ᎦᎶᏐᏅ, ᏎᏓᏂ ᏛᎠᏥᎧᏂ ᏛᎠᏥᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎠᏥᏍᏚᎲᎢ;
english: And when the thousand years are finished, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,

cherokee: ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗᏃ ᎨᏒ ᎠᎴ ᏨᏍᎩᏃ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏨᏓᎸ ᏫᏕᎨᎦᏓᎢᏅᏒᎩ. ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏔᎵᏁ ᎠᏲᎱᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: And death and Hades were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death, even the lake of fire.

cherokee: ᎾᏂᎥᏃ ᎩᎶ (ᏚᎾᏙᎥ) ᏂᏗᎪᏪᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᏛ ᎠᏓᏁᎯ ᎪᏪᎵᎯ, ᏫᏕᎨᎦᏓᎢᎡᎬᎩ ᎠᏥᎸ ᏨᏓᎸᎢ.
english: And if any was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

cherokee: ᎠᏴ ᎡᎵᏆ ᎠᎴ ᎣᎻᎦ, ᏗᏓᎴᏅᏗᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏍᏆᏗᏍᏗᏍᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᎢᎬᏱᏱ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏍᏆᎸᎢ.
english: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
I laughed.
Yeah, she probably would have.

cherokee: ᏓᏆᎴᎿ ᏂᎦᏓ ᎦᏥᏲᎵᎳ ᏃᎴ ᏓᏊᎧᏔᏅ ᎠᏆᏂᎩᏍᏗᏱ.
english: I got up, met everybody, and decided I would take my leave.
That was freedom.

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᏓᏂᎳᏫᎬᎢ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᎪᎸᏔᏅ ᎠᎾᏓᏩᏛᎯᏙ ᎤᏂᎪᎵᏰᎢᏓᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏙᏢᏒ ᎤᏃᏢᎯᏌᏅᎢ.
english: The ceremony allowed visitors to look at the site’s improvements.

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᏍᎦᏚᎩ....... ᏍᏈᏓ ᎠᎲᎢ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ ᎧᏃᎮᏢᏅᎢ.
english: The state...had a lot of misinformation.

cherokee: ᏝᏃ ᎦᏅᏙᎩ ᎪᎢ ᏗᏂᎩᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏱᏚᏂᎮ ᎾᎯᏳᎢ.
english: There was no chainsaws used at this time.

cherokee: ᎣᏂᏃ ᏚᏍᏆᏓ, ᏓᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᎬ ᎤᏓᎴᏅᎲ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ ᏚᎾᏕᎶᏆᎥ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏓ.
english: After he finished it, literacy rates among Cherokees soared within a few years.

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᎤᏪᏅᏏ ᎠᏠᏯᏍᏗ ᏌᏊ ᎧᏅᏑᎵ ᎤᏓᏁᎳ ᎠᎴ ᎾᎠᏂᎨ 200 ᎢᏳᏟᎶᏓ.
english: The homestead includes a one-room cabin and nearly 200 acres.
Through the woods they traveled, and to the market.
When they came back they had heavy loads.

cherokee: ᏍᏈᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ ᎠᏂᏰᎮ, ᏙᎯ ᎢᏳᏅᏁ ᏃᎴ ᎤᎾᎵᏍᏓᏴᏗ.
english: Plenty of food they had, to keep them well and fed.

cherokee: ᎦᏚᎲ ᏩᏚᏂᏐᏤ, ᏍᏗᏫ ᎤᏤᎵ ᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᎥᏂ ᏭᏂᎷᏤ.
english: Crossing into the village, they came close to Stephen’s door.

cherokee: ᏭᏂᎷᏣ ᎭᎾ ᏣᎵ ᏕᎨᏯᏔᎲᏍᎬ ᎠᏍᏓᏱ ᎤᏙᎯᏎ.
english: When they got there Charlie gave a warning shout.
There, before the door, lay a great serpent.
They cried out with fear, dropping their burdens.
They backed up, observing the beast.
Deadly markings it bore upon its carapace scales.
It seemed to sleep.
They threw rocks at it.
Sluggishly it rose to life.
They had no weapon to slay it with.
They went to the storage house.
They found a key - long, of iron.
They found a tube of wood.

cherokee: ᏍᎩᏃ ᏚᏂᏅᏎ ᎢᎾᏓ ᏗᎦᏅᎬ ᎢᏗᏣ, ᎠᏍᎪᎵᏃ ᎤᏁᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏁᎵᏎ.
english: These they took back toward the beast, with plans to snare its head.

cherokee: ᏣᎵ ᎤᏌᎵᏓᏁ ᎤᏔᏂᏓ ᏅᏯ, ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᏚᎩᏍᏗ ᎬᏗ ᏍᏗᏫ ᎤᏪᏍᎯᏔᏁ ᎤᏔᏂᏓ ᎢᎾᏓ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ.
english: Stephen snared the head of the great serpent with the iron key as Charlie hefted the boulder.

cherokee: ᎤᏔᏂᏓ ᎢᎾᏓ ᎤᏍᎦᏎᏗ ᎤᏦᏔᎮ ᏃᎴ ᎤᏩᏂᏍᏓᏂᏙᎴ, ᎤᏔᎶᎩᏍᎨ.
english: The beast hissed menacingly and thrashed around, its great maw gaping.
Up it looked as the stone fell from above.
The blow glanced off the key.
Angered, the beast writhed in its prison.

cherokee: ᏍᏗᏫ ᏚᏓᎵᏴᎮ ᎠᏁᎸᏗᏍᎬ ᎣᏍᏓ ᎤᏂᏴᏗ, ᎦᏚᎲ ᏗᏁ ᎤᎾᏰᎶᎴ.
english: As Stephen fought to hold it, some townspeople approached.

cherokee: ᏣᎵ ᏃᎴ ᏍᏗᏫ ᏚᏂᏁᏤᎴ ᎢᏴ ᏗᏗᏳᎾᎴᏗ.
english: Charlie and Stephen bade them stay back.
Then Charlie went to fetch his armor.

cherokee: ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏧᏅᎪᏤ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᎢᏗᎦᏘ ᏗᎳᏑᎶ ᏧᎳᏑᎵ, ᎪᎢ ᎦᏂᏤᎮ ᏃᎴ ᎦᏅᎯᏓ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ ᎦᏁᎮ.
english: He emerged from the house with boots, with oil, and with sword.

cherokee: ᏍᏗᏫ ᎠᏥᏁᏤᎴ ᎤᏂᏴᏗ ᎢᎾᏓ ᎪᎢ ᎠᏍᏚᏥᏍᎬ ᎢᏳᎯ.
english: He told Stephen to hold the beast while he soaked it in oil.

cherokee: ᎢᎾᏓ ᎤᏙᏳ ᏥᎨᏐ ᏧᏂᎦᎸᏍᏓᏁ ᏚᏴᎯᎲ ᎠᏒᎬ ᎪᎢ.
english: The serpent went mad with the oil fumes.
Wriggling free of its bonds, it fled for the nearby rocks.

cherokee: ᏍᏗᏫ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᏭᏥᏍᏓᎵᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᏣᎵ ᎤᏅᏍᏓᏕᎴ.
english: Stephen wanted to light it aflame, but Charlie held him back.
Stephen was inclined to defer to his wisdom.

cherokee: ᎠᏓ ᎬᏗ ᏭᏂᏴᎮ ᎢᎾᏓ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ, Ꮓ ᏅᏲᎯ ᎦᏙ ᏫᏄᏩᏁᎴ.
english: Stephen caught the beast’s head in the wooden tube and buried it in the rocky soil.

cherokee: ᎠᏎᎪᎩᏓ ᎨᏒ ᎢᎾᏓ, ᏣᎵ ᎤᎳᏏᏂᏗ ᎾᎥ ᏭᎷᏤ.
english: Trapped as the creature was then, Charlie crept up on it.

cherokee: ᎠᏯᏛᎥ ᎦᏅᎯᏓ ᎠᏰᎳᏍᏗ ᎬᏗ, ᎢᏴ ᎤᏌᎵᏓᏁ, ᎠᏓ ᏓᏓᏧᎬ ᏭᏓᎩᏅᏎᎢ.
english: With the flat of his sword, he hoisted it into the air and flung it into the woods.

cherokee: ᏍᎩᏃ ᎢᎾᏓ ᎨᏍᏗ ᎯᎸᎯᏳ ᏔᎵᏁ ᏳᏂᎪᎮ ᎠᎴ ᏳᎾᏛᎪᏓᏁᎢ.
english: And the serpent was never seen or heard from again.

cherokee: ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᎨᏒ ᏂᎦᏓ ᎢᎾᎨ ᎠᏁᎯ ᏣᎳᎩ ᏣᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ.
english: In the forever that was, all the forest dwellers spoke Cherokee.

cherokee: ᎤᏪᏴ ᎾᎥ ᏥᏍᏚ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎶᎵ ᏓᎾᏟᏃᎮᏍᎬ.
english: Near a river, Rabbit and Squirrel were talking.
There, in the direction of the river, Beaver was coming.

cherokee: ᎤᎿᏛ ᏚᏂᏙᎬ ᏥᏍᏚ ᎠᎴ ᏌᎶᎵ ᏭᎷᏤ ᏙᏯ.
english: There, where rabbit and squirrel stood, Beaver arrived.

cherokee: ᎤᏪᏯ ᎾᎥ ᏩᎾᎢᏒ, ᏩᎭᏯ ᎾᎥ ᎤᎦᏌᏗᏣ…
english: As they were walking near the river, suddenly Wolf appeared at their side.

cherokee: ᎨᏍᏓᏛ ᏯᏂᏍᎦᎮ ᏩᎭᏯ, ᎠᏎᏍᎩᎾ ᏙᏳ ᎤᏦᏎᏗ ᏣᏁᎵᏍᎬ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏩᎭᏯ.
english: They were not afraid of Wolf, but they thought that he was truly annoying.
Wolf thought he knew everything.
All of them headed in the direction of the river.

cherokee: ᎤᎿᏛ ᎢᎾ ᎤᏛᏒ ᎨᏒ ᎦᏅᎦᏟ ᏭᎶᏎ ᏩᎭᏯ.
english: There, into the tall grass, went Wolf.
He found what Beaver was talking about.
Now, Wolf began smelling.
Soon, he sat down.
Rabbit, however, knew that Wolf was lying.
It wasn't a shoe.

cherokee: ᏥᏍᏚᏛ ᏙᏳ ᎤᏩᎾᏖ Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ.
english: Rabbit knew very well what it was.
It was a trap.

cherokee: ᎤᎿᏛ ᎠᏒᏛ ᏗᎦᎾᎥ ᏗᏣ ᏭᎶᏎ ᏩᎭᏯ.
english: Wolf went to where the trap lay.
He stepped there, where the trap lay…
Kaweh!! It clanged hard.
Wolf was in serious pain.
He barely spoke…
As it was, Beaver had to fell the tree.
The trap was hooked there.
When he finished, they headed toward the river.
As they walked along, Beaver found another trap.

cherokee: ᎠᏒᏛᏓ ᏗᏥᏯ ᏭᎶᏎ ᏩᎭᏯ ᏃᎴ ᏭᎳᏏᏁ.
english: Wolf went to where the trap lay and stepped in it.
The trap clanged hard.

cherokee: ᎾᎾᏃ ᏩᎭᏯ ᎦᏂᏓᏛ ᏃᎴ ᏗᎦᎴᎾ ᏗᏍᏛᎦᏴᎮᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ.
english: Then Wolf's tail and ears stiffened.
The wolf's feet were really hurting.

cherokee: ᏙᏯᏛ ᎤᏍᎪᎵᏍᏗ ᎥᎨᏒ ᏗᏧᎬ ᎠᏒᏛᏗ ᏫᎫᏓᎸ.
english: Beaver had to gnaw the tree the trap was hooked to.

cherokee: ᏙᏳ ᎠᎩᏠᎨ ᏩᎢᏒ ᏩᎭᏯ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᏰᏗᎮ.
english: Wolf walked along and moaned in agony.
Now Squirrel saw another shoe.

cherokee: ᏒᏛᏓ ᏗᏥᏯ ᏭᏏᏅᏎ, ᏭᏔᏍᏖᏎ ᎣᏂ ᏗᏣ ᎦᏅᏒᏓ.
english: He backed up to where the trap lay and stepped on it with his rear foot.
The trap clanged hard.
Now Beaver cut down the tree that the trap was tied to.
He barely spoke.
Wolf's feet were really hurting.
He arrived near where the trap lay.
He backed up to it.
Quickly, he jumped away!
The other four-footeds removed them.
When they were done, Wolf sat down.
That's the reason the wolf walks around alone.
Wolf still pretends he knows everything.

cherokee: ᏃᎴ ᏍᏉ ᏄᏓᎴ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎪ, ᏱᏣᏕᎶᎰᏒᎾ ᏱᎩ -- ᎦᏓ.
english: But she also looks at something you might not notice -- soil.
Scientists study the natural world.
Asmeret is a soil scientist.

cherokee: ᎦᏓ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎪ ᏃᎴ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᎦᏓ.
english: She studies soil and what makes soil.
Asmeret looks everywhere for evidence of soil being made.
Let's go for a walk in the woods with Asmeret.
Let's see what we can find.
Asmeret takes a handful of soil.
She says lots of things go into the soil.
Soil comes from rocks breaking down.
It also comes from dead organisms.
The dead organisms decompose.
That means they break down into smaller and smaller pieces.
Then they become part of the soil.
Water and air mix with these things are part of the soil, too.

cherokee: ᏂᎦᏓᏗ ᎠᎾᎥ ᎠᏙᎯ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎦᏓ ᎢᏳᎵᏍᏙᏗ.
english: Asmeret says everything in the woods could become part of the soil.

cherokee: ᏅᏯ, ᏧᏆᎶᎦ, ᏃᎴ ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ ᏰᎵᏉ ᎦᏓ ᏫᎾᎵᏍᏗ.
english: The rocks, the leaves and wood and even the animals could become soil someday.
When organisms decompose, they make rich soil.
Rich soil has lots of nutrients.
Plants need nutrients to grow.

cherokee: ᎠᎵᏰᎾ ᏩᏎᎯ ᎪᎯᏳᏙᏗ ᏕᏧᎬ ᏚᎪᏍᎬ ᎦᏙᎯ.
english: Asmeret points to evidence of trees decomposing into soil.
This is a tree.
This is a dead tree.
This is a tree that died years ago.
If you look closely you can see that it is decomposing into soil.
This is a tree that died many years ago.
Now it is soil.

cherokee: ᎠᎵᏰᎾ ᎬᏂᎨᏒ ᏂᎬᏁ ᎫᎪᏗᏍᎩ ᏧᏆᎶᎦ ᏫᏚᎪᏍᎬ ᎦᏙᎯ.
english: Asmeret shows us evidence of leaves decomposing into soil, too.
This is a leaf.
This is a dead leaf.
This is a leaf that died months ago.
These are leaves that have decomposed into soil.

cherokee: ᎠᏛᎯᏍᏗᏍᎩ ᏧᏆᎶᎬ ᏧᏓᏑᏴ ᎦᏙ ᎤᏓᏑᏯ ᏃᏉ.
english: The nutrients that were in the leaves are now in the soil.

cherokee: ᎤᏭᎬᏙᏗ ᎠᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ ᏚᎾᎪᏍᎬ ᎦᏙᎯ ᎠᎵᏰᎾ.
english: Asmeret even finds evidence of animals decomposing into soil.
This is a snake.

cherokee: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎢᎾᏓ ᏧᎪᎳ, ᏰᎵ ᎢᏯᏅᏓ ᎤᎵᏬᏨ.
english: These are the bones of a snake that died months ago.
It is part of the soil.
The nutrients from the snake are becoming part of the soil.
Other organisms make them into soil.
These organisms are called decomposers.

cherokee: ᎤᎪᏏᏓ ᎢᏗᏅᏁ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᎤᎵᏬᏨ ᎦᏓ ᎾᏅᏁᎰ.
english: Decomposers break dead things down into soil.
They add nutrients to the soil.
Here are a few decomposers.
Slug
Today it is sunny outside.
Asmeret wonders if we will find many decomposers.

cherokee: ᎦᏓᏁᏍᏛ ᏃᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎬ ᎠᏁᎰ ᎤᎪᏏᏓ ᎢᏗᏅᏁ.
english: Most decomposers live in wet and dark places.

cherokee: ᎤᏗᎴᎩ ᏱᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ, ᏧᏆᎶᎦ ᏃᎴ ᏗᏒᏆᎶᎩ ᎭᏫᏂᏣ ᏚᏲᎰ ᎤᎪᏏᏓ ᎢᏗᏅᏁ.
english: On a hot day like this, Asmeret looks for decomposers under leaves and logs.
It's wet and dark there.
These are good spots for decomposers to hide from the sunlight.

cherokee: ᏒᏆᎶᏍᏗ ᎭᏫᏂᏣ ᏓᏩᏔ ᎤᎪᏏᏓ ᎢᏗᏅᏁ ᎠᎵᏰᎾ!
english: Asmeret has found some decomposers under a log!
They are millipedes.

cherokee: ᎠᏤ ᎡᎾᎢ ᎠᏂᎩᏍᎪ ᏃᎴ ᏧᎾᏗᎩᏓ ᏓᏂᎯᏯᏍᎪ ᎦᏙᎯ.
english: Millipedes eat dead plants and then leave droppings on the ground.
The droppings help make new soil.

cherokee: ᎤᎵᏏᏅᏗ ᏩᏗᎦ ᎠᏒᏆᎶᏍᏗ ᎠᎵᏰᎾ, ᏥᏄᏍᏛᎩ ᎤᏩᏛᎲ.
english: Asmeret carefully puts the log back the way she found it.

cherokee: ᎠᏍᏕᎵᎭ ᎦᏓᏁ ᏃᎴ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᎤᏳᏓᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏒᏆᎶᏍᏗ ᎭᏫᏂᏣ.
english: This helps keep it wet and dark under the log.

cherokee: ᏃᏗ ᏒᎾᎢ ᏃᎴ ᎠᎾᏓᎴᏴᏗᏍᎩ ᎢᏳᏂᏍᏗ ᎭᏁᎰᎢ ᎭᎾᏂ.
english: Then organisms like millipedes can still live there.
Asmeret looks under another log.
She is very excited.
She found an earthworm with its droppings!
There is evidence of soil being made right now.

cherokee: ᎠᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᎵᏰᎾ, ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎵᏬᏨ ᏓᏂᏯᎩᏍᎪ ᎤᏂᏥᏯ ᏃᏗ ᎦᏙ ᏫᏓᎾᏗᎩᏍᎪ.
english: Asmeret says earthworms eat dead things and then leave droppings in the soil.
The droppings put nutrients in the soil.
Asmeret has found a beautiful fungus.
A fungus is a decomposer, too.
This fungus lives on a dead tree.
The fungus breaks wood down into soil.

cherokee: ᏫᏥᎢᎦ ᎨᏒ ᎨᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᎪᏩᏛᏗᏱᎩ ᎤᎪᏏᏓ ᎢᏯᏅᏁ.
english: Most decomposers are so small that you can't even see them.
This is a picture of bacteria.

cherokee: ᏂᎦᏓ ᎥᏳᎩ ᏗᏂᏱᏙ ᏥᏓᏥᎶᏍᏗ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏗᎦᎸᏗ ᎠᎴᏫᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬ.
english: All of the bacteria in this picture could fit on the period at the end of this sentence.

cherokee: ᎤᏔᏂᏗᎨ ᎢᏳᏅᏁᎸ ᏓᏥᎶᏍᏛ ᎣᎯᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᏣᎪᏩᏛᏗ ᎤᏳᎦ ᏗᏂᏱᏙᎢ.
english: This picture has been made much bigger so you can see the bacteria.
Bacteria are almost everywhere.
They live in the soil.
They live in the water.

cherokee: ᏅᎩ ᏗᏂᏅᏌᏗ ᏃᎴ ᎠᏤ ᎠᎾᎢ ᎠᏁᎰᎢ.
english: They live on animals and plants.
They break dead things down into soil.

cherokee: ᎠᎵᏰᎾ ᏩᏎᎯ ᎠᏗᏅᏓ ᎦᎳᎨᏴ ᎤᏃᎯ ᎾᎥᏂ.
english: Asmeret points to some trash near the trail.

cherokee: ᎨᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏳᏰᎸᎰ ᎤᏩᏛᏗ ᎠᏗᏅᏓ ᎠᏙᎯ.
english: She doesn't like to find trash in the woods.
Trash takes a long time to decompose.

cherokee: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎦᏅᏙᏗ ᎣᏂᏴ ᎩᎶ ᎠᏙᎯ.
english: This is a paper bag that someone left in the woods.
This is the same bag after one month.
After one year, the bag has decomposed.

cherokee: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎢᎦᏓ ᎠᏕᏅᏓ ᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ.
english: But some trash never decomposes.

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᎤᏁᏍᏓᎳ ᎫᎦ ᎨᏍᏗ ᎦᏓ ᏱᏂᏓᎦᎵᏍᏔᎾ ᏰᎵ ᎢᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏓ.
english: This glass bottle will not become soil for thousands of years.
Decomposers will break it all down into soil.

cherokee: ᏃᏗ ᎭᏕᎶᎰ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬ ᎠᏙᎯ ᎦᏓ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᎵᏰᎾ.
english: Now you've seen how a soil scientist like Asmeret looks at the woods.

cherokee: ᎠᏐᏩᏘᏍᎪ ᎦᏓ ᏃᎴ ᎤᎪᏏᏓ ᎢᏯᏅᏁ ᏂᎬᎾᏛᎢ.
english: She sees soil and decomposers everywhere.
She wonders about what she observes in the soil.
Asmeret is always asking questions.

cherokee: ᎪᎨᏱᏨ ᎦᏙ ᏩᎾᎯ ᏱᏄᎵᏍᏔᎾ ᎦᏓᎷᎪᏗ, ᎠᏆᏤᎵ ᏏᏓᏁᎸ ᎣᏣᎴᏂᏍᎪ ᎣᏥᏫᏒᎥᏍᎬᎢ.
english: In the spring when the ground gets soft enough to turn, our family start putting in our garden.

cherokee: ᎤᎾᏨᏓᎵ ᎠᏎ ᎢᎪᎯᏓ ᎠᎬᏱ ᏗᏫᏍᏗ ᎨᏐᎢ.
english: The peas are always planted first.

cherokee: ᏧᎾᏍᏗᎧᎨ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ ᎪᏍᏓᏯ ᎠᏓ ᎬᏗ ᏓᏂᏔᎴᏍᎪ Ꮓ ᎤᏂᏖᎸᏅ ᎤᎾᏨᏓᎵ ᏐᏉᎭ ᏓᏂᏔᏁᎪᎢ ᏓᏔᎴᏒᎢ.
english: The smaller children make holes with a stick and drop a dried up pea into each one.

cherokee: ᏓᎦᎵᏍᎬ ᏃᎴ ᏓᎦᏍᎬ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸᎾ ᎦᏙᎯ ᏗᎾᎪᏘᏍᎪ ᎤᎾᏨᏓᎵ.
english: With the sun and rain, the peas start to peek through the earth.

cherokee: ᏧᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏰᏌᏛ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏕᎦᎾᏅᎪᎪ ᎠᏍᏘ ᏧᏂᏂᏙᏗ.
english: Little fingers push through to reach for a string to hold onto.

cherokee: ᎾᎯᏳ ᎤᎾᏨᏓᎵ ᎠᎾᏓᏛᎥᎦ, ᎤᏙᎯᏳ ᎤᏂᎦᎾᏍᏓ, ᏙᏣᏓᎩᏍᎪ ᏃᎴ ᎭᎾᏊ ᏙᏥᏯᎩᏍᎪ.
english: When the peas come in, they are so sweet we pick and eat them right there.

cherokee: ᎤᏂᏁᎫᎯᏍᏗ ᎤᎦᏔ ᏍᏉ ᎢᎬᏱᏊ ᏙᏥᏫᏍᎪ, ᏙᏣᎪᏎᏍᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᎦᎾᏬᎲᏍᎬ ᎢᎪᎯᏓ ᎩᎳᏃ ᎦᏙ ᏫᏙᏥᏰᎲᏍᏗᏍᎪᎢ.
english: We start tomatoes early, helping them along until it gets warm enough to put them in the ground.

cherokee: ᏧᎵᏏᏅᏓ ᏙᏧᏒᎥᏍᎪ ᏗᏓᎨ ᏗᏰᎲᏍᏓᏅ Ꮓ … ᎰᏥᎦᏘᏗᏍᎪ ᏳᎦᎾᏬᏒ ᏙᏥᎦᎵᎯᏍᏗᏍᎪ.
english: Every night we cover the seedlings and wait until it is warm enough during the day to set them out for sunshine.

cherokee: ᏩᎾᏗᎳᏍᎦᎶᏗ ᏥᎾᏕᏆᎳ ᎢᏗᎩᏓ ᎤᏂᏁᎫᎯᏍᏗ ᏃᎴ ᎢᎦᏛ ᏩᏥᎾᏚᏍᏗᎧᎸ ᏎᏗ ᏥᏂᏚᏍᏗᎧᎸ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: The tomatoes are as big as softballs and some are smaller than walnuts.
They are sweet and tart at the same time.

cherokee: ᎢᎦᏓ ᏧᎾᏦᏍᏗ ᎠᎩᏍᏗ Ꮎ ᏍᎩᏅ ᎭᎴᏉ ᏂᏙᎩᏨᏍᎪ ᏦᏥᏅᎪᎢ.
english: Some have an acid taste that almost stings our tongues.
There are all kinds of peppers in our garden.

cherokee: ᎠᎩᏚᏓ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎠᏎ ᏓᏁᎶᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᎾᏗᎴᎩ ᎨᏒᎢ, ᎢᎦᏛ ᏍᏆᏂᏯ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᏧᎦᎾᏮ ᏗᏳᎾᏓᎴᏅᎯ.
english: Grandpa always tries the hottest kinds, even some from South America.

cherokee: ᎤᏂᎦᎾᏍᏓ ᎤᏂᏥᎸᎢ ᏃᎴ ᎤᏂᏍᏓᎦᏴᎯᏓ, ᎠᎹ ᎤᏂᏁ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏃᎴ ᎪᎨ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎦᏫᏒᎢᏍᏗ ᏱᏩᏥᏍᏓᎩᏌ.
english: The sweet peppers are crisp and watery and they taste and smell like summer.

cherokee: ᎠᎩᏚᏚ ᏍᏊ ᎢᎪᎯᏓ ᏓᏁᎶᏗᏍᎪ ᎤᎾᏗᎴᎩ ᏥᎩ ᎢᏳᎾᏍᏗ, ᏍᏆᏂᏯ ᎤᎦᎾᏮ ᎠᎹᏰᎵ ᏗᏳᎾᏓᎴᏅ.
english: Granddad always tries the hottests kinds, even some from South America.

cherokee: ᎣᎩᎨᏳᎯ ᎡᏆ ᎪᎨ ᎣᎩᏫᏒᏅᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎨᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᏳᎸᏉᏙᎢ ᎠᏂᏤ ᏚᏯ ᏧᏓᎩᏍᏗ ᎤᏗᎴᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎪᎨᎢ!
english: We love our big summer garden, but no body likes to pick green beans on hot summer days!
Hot summer days are for swimming!
At the base of a large mountain was a small pond.
Many fish lived in the pond.

cherokee: ᏫᏥ ᎢᏯᏂ ᎤᏐᏱ ᏗᎨᎦᏃᏗ ᎨᏎ, ᏐᏉ ᎤᏩᏌ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ Ꮳ.
english: Most of them looked the same, except for one small fish.
All the other fish called him Littlefish.

cherokee: ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎮ ᏂᎦᏓ ᎠᏣᏗ ... ᏣᏉᏲᎪ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ.
english: The fish all lived happily in the small pond … except for Littlefish.
The larger fish always bossed him around.

cherokee: ᎾᎥᏂᎨ ᏭᎷᏤᎢ ᏃᎴ ᏚᎦᏙᏍᏔᏁᎢ ᏧᏆᎶᎦ ᏃᎴ ᏧᏍᏗ ᏧᏩᏂᎦᏝᏅ ᏫᏓᏳᎢᏅᏍᎨᎢ ᎠᏔᎴᎦᏒ.
english: He swam closer and watched leaves and small twigs float down the hole.

cherokee: ᎤᏛᎦᏍᏔᏁ ᎠᎹ ᏫᎦᎶᏍᎬ ᎠᏔᎴᎦᏒ ᏃᎴ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎭᎾ ᏫᏗᎦᎶᏍᎬ ᎠᎹ, ᏧᏆᎶᎦ ᏃᎴ ᏧᏍᏗ ᏧᏩᏂᎦᏝᏅ.
english: He listened to the water as it flowed through the hole and wondered where the water, leaves, and twigs were going.

cherokee: ᎾᎥᏂᎨ ᏭᎷᏣ, ᏅᏛᎦᏁ ᎡᏆ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏧᏪᎷᏁ.
english: As he swam closer still he heard a large fish yell.
He turned to swim away, but it was too late.

cherokee: ᎤᏟᏂᎩᏓ ᎨᏎ ᎨᏴᎢ ᎠᎹ, ᏚᎧᏔᏍᏔᏁᎢ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏭᎾᏌᎾᎩᏎ, ᎠᏲᏟᎨ ᏗᎦᏁᎲ ᏭᎸᏥᎴ.
english: The current of the water was too strong and Littlefish closed his eyes as it pulled him through into a smaller pool.
He swam around until he found the entrance he came through.

cherokee: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎦᏣᏄᎵ ᏫᎨᏰᎢ ᎠᎹ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎭᏂᏣ ᏭᏓᏬᏍᏗ.
english: But the water was flowing too fast for such a small fish to swim against.

cherokee: ᎤᏁᎸᏔᏁ ᏫᏄᏪᏎᏗ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎡᏝᏪᎯ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎨ, ᎠᎹ ᎤᏃᏴᎬ ᏭᎵᏛᏓᏁᎢ.
english: He tried to yell back to her, but his tiny voice disappeared in the roar of the water.
Littlefish swam slowly around the pool for several days.
He wondered why.

cherokee: ᎤᏩᏅᏓᏕᎢ ᏰᎵ ᏎᎦ ᏳᎦᎾᏅᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᎡᎳᏗ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᎹ.
english: He remembered that when the rain didn't come for a few days, the water level would drop.
When the next rain came, the pool would fill up again.

cherokee: ᏭᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᏄᏪᏎᎸ ᎤᏥ, ᏁᎳᎩᏃ ᏣᏍᎦᎢᎮ, ᏫᏥ ᏭᏓᏬᎥᏍᏗ ᏚᏭᎪᏔᏁᎢ.
english: Littlefish thought of what his mother had said, and although he was scared, he decided to swim on.

cherokee: ᎨᎢᏗᏣ ᏫᎨᏴ ᏭᎧᏔᏁᎢ, ᏚᎧᏔᏍᏔᏁᎢ, ᏭᏅᎪᏤᎢ ᎠᎹ ᎦᏁᎲ.
english: He faced the water flowing downstream, closed his eyes, and although he was scared, he decided to swim on.
Littlefish remembered what the big fish had said to him, so …
He didn't swim too close to the top of the water.
He didn’t swim too close to the side of the water.
He didn’t swim too close to the bottom of the water.

cherokee: ᏔᎵᏁᎢ ᎠᎹ ᎦᏁᎲᎢ, ᎤᏓᎴᏨ ᏗᎧᏃᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎤᎪᎮᎢ.
english: In the next pool of water he saw an odd looking fish.

cherokee: ᎤᏬᏗᎨ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᎨᏎᎢ ᏃᎴ ᏌᏬᏚ ᎤᏓᏅᎵᏰᏓ ᏄᏍᏕᎢ.
english: It was dark brown and seemed to be covered in mud.

cherokee: ᎤᏓᎴᏨ ᎠᏤᎯ ᎠᏣᏗ, ᏅᎩ ᏕᎦᏅᏌᏛ ᏕᎬᏗᏍᎨ ᎡᏙᎲ ᎠᎼ ᎡᎳᏗ.
english: The strange new fish walked along the bottom of the stream on four legs.
He was startled by the voice.

cherokee: ᎤᎧᏖᏃᎴ ᏎᎦ, ᎤᎪᎮᎢ ᎩᎦᎨ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏧᏅᎪᏤᎢ ᏅᏲ ᎭᏫᏂᏣ.
english: He looked around until he saw a red fish emerge from under a rock.

cherokee: ᏔᎵᏁ ᏗᎦᏁᎲ ᏭᎷᏣ, ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏣᏗ ᎤᎪᎮ. ᏅᏲ ᏥᎦᏯᎶ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏄᏍᏕ.
english: In the next pool, Littlefish saw a small fish that seemed to be stuck to a rock.

cherokee: ᎨᏍᏗ ᏳᏪᎵᏌ, ᎠᏓᏬᏍᎬ ᎡᏉᎯᎨ ᏃᎴ ᎦᏣᏄᎵᎨ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨᎢ ᎨᏴᎢ.
english: He did not notice that as he swam on the stream grew larger and faster.
You are just as big as me

cherokee: ᏫᏥ ᎢᏣ ᏭᏓᏬᎠ ᎤᏍᏗᎢ ᎠᏣᏗ, ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᏄᏪᏒ ᎡᏆ ᎠᏣᏗ.
english: As he swam on, Littlefish though about what the big fish had said.
He saw many different fish of all shapes, sizes, and colors.

cherokee: ᎩᎳ ᎤᏕᎶᎰᏎ ᎤᏂᎩᏏᏗᏒ, ᎡᏆ ᎠᏣᏗ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ ᏃᎴ ᎨᏍᏗ ᏯᏍᎦᎢᎮ.
english: Littlefish realized that somewhere along his journey he had grown into a large fish and that he was no longer afraid.

cherokee: ᏃᎴ ᎠᏛᏍᎨ ᎨᏴᎢ, ᎭᏫᏂᎨ ᏃᎴ ᎦᏣᏄᎵᎨ ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᎨᏴᎢ.
english: And with the rain, the creek grew deeper and the water flowed faster.

cherokee: ᏭᏓᏅᏖᎴ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎨᏴ ᏭᏘᏃᎸ ᎤᏔᏂᏗᎨ ᎨᏴᎢ.
english: Littlefish thought about the stream that had brought him to the creek.

cherokee: ᎤᎦᏅᎾ ᏄᏪᏂᏌᏁ ᎤᎵᏌᎵᏓᏁ ᎨᏴ, ᏰᎵᏉ ᎠᏍᏛᎩ ᎨᏎ ᏦᎩ ᎢᏣ ᏭᏓᏬᎥᏍᏗ.
english: The rain caused the stream to rise, and, now it would be deep enough for him to swim up stream.

cherokee: ᎤᏩᏓᎷᏯᏛ ᎬᏗ ᏚᏲᎵᎴ ᏃᏗ ᏭᏓᏬᎡ ᏫᏥ.
english: He waved to them with his fin and swam on.

cherokee: ᏎᎦᏨ, ᏭᎷᏤ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᎹ ᎦᏁᎲ ᎡᏆ ᏅᏯ ᎤᎵᏗᏨ.
english: Finally, he came to the small pond at the base of the large rock.

cherokee: ᏫᏥ ᏩᏓᏬᎢᎡ, ᎾᎨᎢᏴ ᎣᏁ ᎢᏣ ᏅᏲ ᎭᏫᏂᏣ ᎤᏛᎦᏁ ᏂᏗᎦᏪᏍᎬ.
english: As Littlefish swam on, he heard a distant voice coming from behind him out of the opening beside the large rock.
Wendy woke up early one morning.

cherokee: ᎤᎬᏍᏉᎡ, ᏕᎦᏅᏙᎬ ᏚᏅᎦᎸᎮ, ᏃᏉ ᏚᎭᏯᎴ ᏧᎿᏬᏍᏗ.
english: She washed her face, brushed her teeth, and began choosing clothes to wear.
She looked outside and saw the sun shining.

cherokee: ᎢᏤ ᎤᎵᏑᏫᏓ ᏧᏍᏆᎳ ᏗᎦᏅᏌᏗ ᎤᏑᎳᏁ ᏃᎴ ᏌᎪᏂᎨ ᎤᏁᎦ ᏧᎶᎳᏗ ᏧᏍᏆᎳ ᏗᎪᎭᏯᏗ ᎤᎿᏬᎡ.
english: She put on green shorts and a blue and white striped tank top.

cherokee: ᏙᏱ ᏭᎷᏣ ᎠᎦᎵᎮ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎤᏴᏣ ᎨᏎ ᏃᎴ ᎤᏩᏃᏪ.
english: When she stepped outside, the sun was shining, but it was very cold and she started to shiver.

cherokee: ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏭᏴᎴ ᎤᏃᎴ ᏃᎴ ᎫᏘᏍᎬ ᎠᎿᏬᏍᏗ ᎤᎿᏬᎡ.
english: Wendy went back into the house and put on her snowsuit.

cherokee: ᎠᏎᏃ ... ᎨᏍᏗ ᎫᏩᎩᎸᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏔᎵ ᎩᎦᏆᏘ, ᏃᎴ ᎪᎯᎢᏴ ᎦᎴᏴᏍᎨ ᏚᏄᏮ.
english: But … she could not ride her bicycle, and after a while she was too hot in the suit.

cherokee: ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏭᏴᎴ ᎠᏌᏃ ᎱᎿᏬᎡ, ᎬᎩᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏗᎧᏃᏗ ᏃᎴ ᎠᎵᏍᏇᏔᏬ ᎠᎾᎵᎪᎲᏍᎩ.
english: She went back into the house and put on her dress that looked like a watermelon and the hat that matched.

cherokee: ᏃᏗ ᎱᎦᎿᏁ ᏃᎴ ᎦᏃᎸᎥᏍᎨ, ᎠᎹ ᎦᏁᎲ ᏭᏃᎸᏔᏁ ᎤᎵᏍᏇᏔᏬ.
english: It started to rain and the wind blew her hat in the puddle.
Wendy sighed.

cherokee: ᎨᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏓ ᎢᎦ ᏱᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏪᎵᏎ ᎤᏃᎴ.
english: It didn't seem to be a very good day she thought.

cherokee: ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏭᏴᎴ ᏃᎴ ᏭᎦᏛᏁ ᏧᎿᏬ ᏧᏍᏆᏂᎪᏙᏗ.
english: She went back into her house and looked into her closet again.
All of a sudden she had an idea.
She knew just what to wear.

cherokee: ᎯᎪᎯᏗ ᏙᏱᏨ ᏭᎷᏣ ... ᎠᎵᎬᏓᏃᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏯᏤᎢ ᏃᎴ ᎢᎾ ᎢᏗᎦᏘ ᏚᎳᏑᏞ.
english: This time when she stepped outside … she was wearing her scarf and boots.

cherokee: ᎾᏃ ᎠᏧᏣ ᎠᎹ ᎦᏁᏁᎮᎢ ᎤᎦᏔ ᎠᎴ ᎦᏄᎸ ᎧᎾᏍᏕᎸᎩᏍᎬᎢ.
english: The boy watered the seed and kept the weeds away.
One morning a seedling appeared.

cherokee: ᏗᎦᏃᏣᏢᏍᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎤᏩᏕᏯᏍᏔᏁᎢ ᎢᏈᎬᎢ, ᎥᏍᎩᏃᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎤᎳᏍᏓᏒᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
english: He put a sign around the tree, so no one would step on it.

cherokee: ᎩᎳᏊ ᎢᏴᏃ, Ꮎ ᎤᎦᏔ ᏚᏩᏅᎦᏢᏅᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎪᏗ ᏧᎦᎶᎦ ᏚᏛᏎᎢ.
english: In no time at all, the seedling grew branches and more leaves.
The boy was so proud.

cherokee: ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏈᎬᎢ ᏝᏃ ᏙᏳ ᎤᏬᏚᎯ ᏱᎩᏎᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᏧᏣ ᎤᎨᏳᏎᎢ ᎢᏈᎬᎢ, ᎤᏬᏚᎯ ᎡᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
english: The little tree was not so beautiful, but because the little boy loved the tree so much, the tree felt beautiful.

cherokee: ᎯᎸᏍᎩᏃ ᏫᏄᏒᏢ, ᎤᏍᏗᏃ ᎠᏧᏣ ᎤᏩᏛᎮᎢ ᎢᏈᎬᎢ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏓᏅᏖ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏩᏅᎦᏢ ᏚᏁᏃᏛᎢ.
english: Still a few days later the boy found the little apple tree sad and droopy.

cherokee: ᎤᏂᎩᏌᏃ, ᎤᎪᎮᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏲ ᎤᏓᏅᏖᎢ ᎢᏈᎬᎢ.
english: Yet as he walked away, he saw the tree still looked sad.

cherokee: ᎾᎯᏳᏃ ᎤᏒᎯ ᎢᏈᎬᎢ ᏂᎦᏟᎮ, ᎠᏧᏣᏃ ᏒᎦᏔ ᏚᎧᏁᏞᎢ ᎥᎿ ᎤᏩᏅᎦᏢᎢ ᏒᎦᏔ ᎢᏈᎬᎢ.
english: That night as the tree slept, the boy tied a big red apple on a branch of the little apple tree.
The next morning, the boy went to check on his friend.
And he took a great big bite.

cherokee: ᏓᏓᏁᏟᏴᏎᎬᏃ, ᎠᏧᏣᏃ ᎠᎴ ᏒᎦᏔ ᎢᏈᎬᎢ ᏓᎾᏛᏍᎨᎢ ...
english: As the seasons passed, the boy and the apple tree grew …
They both grew tall and strong.

cherokee: ᎢᎦᏃ ᎤᏬᏚᎯ ᎨᏎᎢ Ꮎ ᏒᎦᏔ ᎢᏈᎬᎢ ...
english: The apple tree was beautiful …
Pink blossoms covered it from tip to top.
Butterfiles, birds, and honey bees came to visit.
And when the pink blossoms fell off …
… yellow apples took their place.

cherokee: ᎤᎾᏥᏍᏈᏍᏛᏃ ᏓᎶᏂᎨ ᏒᎦᏔ ᎤᎾᏔ, ᏚᏩᏅᎦᏢᏃ ᏚᏓᎨᏒᎢ ᏚᏘᏌᏕᎢ.
english: So many yellow apples, the branches bowed from the weight.

cherokee: ᏌᎪᏂᎨ ᏥᏍᏆ ᏧᏓᏏ ᏧᏙᎢᏓ ᎡᎭᎢ, ᎣᏍᏓ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎨᏎᎢ - ᎠᏍᏕᎵᏍᎨᎢ ᎤᏥ ᎠᏛᏅᎢᏍᏗᏍᎬ
english: There was a blue bird named Buddy, as happy as he could be - he was helping his mom get ready.
They were going south, you see.
But in all the excitement A limb, Buddy did not see.
Buddy flew right into the limb
Then went falling to the ground
And he hit it so very hard that his head went round and round.
When he looked up, they were all gone
But no one was there to hear him
He looked with teary eyes so wide.
I'm afraid to be alone, he thought

cherokee: ᏃᏗ ᎤᎵᏏᎩ ᎤᎧᎲᏛ ᎤᎶᏎ ᏅᏙ ᎠᎬᏱᏣ.
english: Then, a dark cloud passed over the moon.
As he walked he tried to be brave
But felt lost in all the trees.
As the night closed in the dark he began to feel the cold.

cherokee: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏑᎾᎴ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᎾ ᎠᎧᏔᎮᎢ ᎫᏩᏟᏫᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏒᎾ.
english: But when the morning came again He knew he could not fly
His wing felt like it was broken.
He shook as the wind blew by.
The wind began to blow so hard

cherokee: ᏃᏗ ᎠᎩᏩᏛᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ ᎤᏓᏅᏗ ᏧᎬ ᏥᏯᎵᏍᎦᏍᏙᏗ.
english: And he felt like he should find some nice tree that he could stay with.
As the Maple snubbed her nose.
I guess I would mess up your looks
The snow is coming down so fast
He began to fall and sway.
Oh yes you can! said a voice
It came from a cedar tree

cherokee: ᎨᏍᏗ ᎠᏉᏚ ᏱᎩ ᏓᏆᏂᎦᏢ ᎨᏍᏗ ᏧᏟᏂᎩᏓ ᏱᎩ.
english: I'm not very pretty at all, and my limbs are not so strong.

cherokee: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏰᎵᏉ ᏱᏂᎾᏛᎦ ᎭᏂᏉ ᎮᎮᏍᏗ ᎪᎳ ᎦᎶᏐᏅ ᎢᎪᎯᏓ.""
english: But we will do the best we can, and stay until winter is gone.
Buddy could not believe his ears

cherokee: ᎭᎾᎾ ᎡᎮᎢ ᎪᎨᏱ ᎢᎪᎯᏓ ᎤᏙᏳ ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᏧᎬ.
english: And there he stayed until spring with the nicest, kindest tree.

cherokee: ᎤᏥ ᏃᎴ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎱᏂᎷᏣ ᏚᏃᎯᏎᎴ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ ᏃᎴ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎤᎪᎲ
english: When mom and dad came back again he told them what he had done and seen

cherokee: Ꮒ! ᏗᏐᎢ ᏕᏧᎬ ᏚᏂᏲᎰᏎᎴ ᏧᏆᎶᎦ. ᎯᎠᏃ ᎢᎪᎯᏓ ᎢᏤᎯ.
english: Look! Other trees had lost their leaves, but this one was forever green.

cherokee: ᏗᏣᎧᏅᎦ ᎢᎾ ᎢᏗᎦᏔ ᏕᏈᎬᎢ, ᎠᏗᎭ ᎡᏙᏓ.
english: Look at the tall trees, says my father.
They are redwood trees.
They have been alive for thousands of years.
They are called Giant Sequoia.

cherokee: ᎯᎢᏃ ᏍᏏᏉᏯ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎤᎵᏍᎨᏓ ᎨᏎ, ᎢᏓᏗᎰ.
english: This Sequoyah must have been famous, we say.
He must have fought bravely and led his people well.
He must have been as tall and as strong as these trees.

cherokee: ᎥᎥ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏪᏍᎬ ᎡᏙᏓ, Ꮭ ᏍᎩᏂ ᏣᏓᏅᏖᎢ.
english: Yes, my father says, but not as you might think.
This man called Sequoyah was crippled.

cherokee: ᎤᏕᏅᏃ ᎧᎸᎬᎢᏗᏟ ᏖᎾᏏ ᎦᎵᏆᏚᎢᏍᎪᎯᏧᏈ ᏑᏓᎵᏍᎪᎯ ᎤᏕᏘᏴᏌᏗᏒ, ᎤᏥᏃ ᎠᏣᎳᎩ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏙᏓ ᎠᏲᏩᏁᎦ ᏱᎨᏎ.
english: He was born in eastern Tennessee in the 1760s, the son of a Cherokee woman and a white man he never knew.

cherokee: ᏍᏏᏉᏯ ᎪᎯᏗ ᎤᎴᏂᏙᎴ Ꮭ ᏧᏓᏃᏣᎵ ᏱᎨᏎ.
english: For much of his life, Sequoyah was nobody famous.

cherokee: ᏔᎷᎩᏍᎩ ᎦᏅᎦᏩᎶᏍᎩ ᎨᏎ ᏗᎦᏁᎦᎳᏫᏍᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏗᏔᎴᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᎪᏢᏍᎬ. Georgia ᎠᏕᎳ ᎤᏁᎦ ᏗᏗᏙᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏴᎩ ᏕᎪᏢᏗᏍᎬ.
english: He was a metalworker who could turn iron into chisels and drills and Georgia silver into forks and spoons.

cherokee: ᏍᏏᏉᏯ Ꮭ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏰᎨᏎ ᎠᏎᏍᎩᏂ ᏚᎨᏳᏒ ᏧᏤᎵ ᎠᏂᏴᏫ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: Sequoyah was not a chief, but he loved his people like one.

cherokee: ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎢᎾ ᎢᏗᎾᏘ ᏧᎾᎳᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎾᏂᎥ ᏴᏫ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎠᏁᎮ.
english: He wanted them to stand as tall as any people on earth.

cherokee: Ꮭ ᏳᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎤᎾᎵᏛᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᎠᏂᏲᏁᎦ ᎢᏳᎾᎵᏍᏙᏗ.
english: He did not want them to disappear in the white man's world.

cherokee: ᎯᎩᏍᎪᎯ ᏳᏕᏘᏴᏓ ᏥᎨᏎ, ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎬ, ᏚᏭᎪᏔᏅ ᏧᏂᏰᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏬᏪᎶᏗ ᎢᏗᏬᏂᏍᎬ.
english: When he was fifty, they say, he decided to capture the people's voices in writing.

cherokee: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏍᏏᏉᏯ, ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎪ, Ꮭ ᎠᏲᏩᏁᎦ ᎪᎵᎦ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᏱᎨᏎ ᏝᏍᏊ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏓᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᎠᏲᏩᏁᎦ ᎤᎪᎵᏰᏗ.
english: But Sequoyah, they tell us, knew no English and couldn't read -- not even the letter A.
But that didn't matter to Sequoyah.
Everyone laughed.
No one believed him.

cherokee: ᏍᏏᏉᏯᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎬ ᏗᎬᏟᎶᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᏗ, ᏌᏊ ᏗᏟᏍᏙᏗ ᏌᏊ ᎢᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗ.
english: Sequoyah began drawing hundreds of symbols, one for each word.

cherokee: ᏧᏒᏓᎷᎩᏃ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏗᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᎤᎧᎵᎡ ᏧᏬᏪᎳᏅ.
english: He scratched them on slats of wood and filled his cabin with shingles of writing.

cherokee: ᏓᏂᏍᎦᎢᎯ ᏧᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏬᏪᎳᏅ ᎤᏐᏅᎢᏃ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎨ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏚᏟᎶᏍᏛ ᎠᎴ ᏚᏬᏪᎸ.
english: They feared his signs were evil.

cherokee: ᏝᏃ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏗᎬᏙᏗ ᏱᎦᎩ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏚᏟᎶᏍᏗ ᎠᎴ ᏥᏚᏬᏪᎳ.
english: They saw no use for writing.

cherokee: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᎾᎪᎲᏍᏔᏁ ᎤᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎴ ᏂᎦᏓ ᏧᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎸ ᏧᏬᏪᎳᏅ ᏚᎪᏁ.
english: So they burned his cabin down and turned his writing into smoke.
But Sequoyah learned a different lesson.

cherokee: ᏃᏊᏃ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏚᏃᏴᎬ ᏗᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏕᎪᏪᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᏴ ᎢᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᏣᎳᎩ.
english: Instead, they tell us, he invented letters to spell out the sounds of the language.

cherokee: ᎡᎵᏊᏃ ᎢᎦ ᏚᏃᏴᎬ ᏚᏬᏪᎳᏅ ᏍᏛᎾ ᏁᎵᏍᎪᎯ ᏅᎩ ᎤᎴᏅᎮ ᏕᎪᏪᎵᏍᎬ ᏗᎧᏁᎢᏍᏗ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ.
english: When he had enough letters -- about eighty-four or so -- he began writing.

cherokee: ᎾᎥᏃ ᎢᏳᎾᏓᎵ ᎤᏂᏑᎵᎪᏤ ᎤᏂᏰᏣᏍᎬ ᎾᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏍᎨ ᏍᏏᏉᏯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏑᏓᎵ ᎢᏳᏕᏘᏴᏓ ᎠᎨᏳᏣ ᎤᏕᎶᏆᎡ ᏧᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏬᏪᎶᏗ.
english: His neighbors stopped laughing when Sequoyah's six-year-old daughter, Ayoka, learned to read.

cherokee: ᎠᏂᏴᏫᏃ ᎤᏂᏑᎵᎪᏤ ᎠᏅᏙᎵᏗᏍᎬ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏔᎵ ᏗᎾᏟᎭ ᎤᎾᎴᏅᏎ ᏓᎾᏓᏙᏪᎳᏁᎲ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏂᎪᎵᏰᏍᎬ ᏣᎳᎩ.
english: The people stopped jeering when two warriors wrote to each other.

cherokee: ᎠᎾᏗᏍᎪᏃ ᎠᏂᏴᏫ ᎤᏟᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏕᎶᏆᎡ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎤᏃᏪᎶᏗ.
english: The people, they say, learned the Cherokee letters quickly.

cherokee: ᏝᏃ ᎢᏳᏬᎯᏤ ᏂᎦᏓ ᏣᎳᎩ ᏗᏂᎪᎵᏰᏍᎩ ᏄᎵᏍᏔᏁ.
english: It was not long, they tell us, before everyone was reading and writing.

cherokee: ᎯᎢᏃ ᏗᏤ ᏚᎾᏔᏁ ᏃᏊ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎠᏰᎵ ᎡᎵᏊ ᏗᎪᏪᎵ ᏚᏂᎴᏴᎠᏁ ᎯᎠ ᏣᎳᎩ ᏗᎬᎪᎵᏰᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏍᏙᎸᏍᏗ ᏂᎨᏒᎾ.
english: With these new signs, the Cherokee nation published newspapers and books and made sure that their words would never fade away.

cherokee: ᎠᎴᏍᏊ ᎥᏳᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎠᏰᏟᏴ ᎤᎾᏗᏨᏁ ᎦᏚᎲ ᏂᎬᏫᏍᏕ ᏚᏂᎾᎡ ᏗᎪᏪᎳᏅ ᏗᏣᎳᎩ ᏗᎪᏪᎵ.
english: Even when sickness half emptied their towns, they kept their writing.

cherokee: ᏧᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ ᏃᏊ ᏧᏓᎴᏅᎲ ᎠᏂᏲᏁᎦ ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᏗᎾᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᎡᎵᏃ ᎪᎯᎩ ᏁᎲᎾ ᎢᎬᏩᎵᏍᏔᏅ ᎨᏎ ᏍᏏᏉᏯ ᏂᎬᏫᏍᏕᏃ ᏓᎾᏅᏓᏗᏍᎨ ᏣᎳᎩ ᏗᎪᏪᎳ.
english: Even when English-speaking teachers ruled their classrooms, long after Sequoyah had passed away, they remembered their letters.
They never let them disappear.

cherokee: ᏧᏓᏃᏣᏟ ᎠᏍᎦᏯ ᎨᏒ, ᎢᏓᏗᏍᎪ, ᎾᏗᎦᎵᏍᏙᏗᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏬᎷᏩᏛᏓ ᏗᎪᏪᎶᏙᏗ ᎠᏯ ᎢᏗᏣᎳᎩ ᎡᎵᏊ ᎨᎪᏪᎶᏗ ᎢᎬᏌ ᎢᎩᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ.
english: He was a famous man, we say, because he invented writing for the Cherokee.
He was a brave man because he never gave up.

cherokee: ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎯ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏪᏲᏁ ᎢᏳᎾᏛᏁᏗ ᎤᏂᎦᏛᎴᎯᏍᏗ ᎾᎦᎥᎢ. ᎢᎾ ᎢᎭᏘ ᏣᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏧᏟᏂᎩᏓ ᏕᏈᎬᎢ ᎾᏍᎩᏯᎢ. ᏣᏟᏂᎩᏓ.
english: He was a leader because he showed his people how to survive -- how to stand tall and proud like these trees.
Spearfinger

cherokee: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏐᏊ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏓᏕᏙᏗᏍᎨᎢ ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ ᎠᏁᎲᎢ... ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏗ!
english: There was one thing that disturbed their happy lives . . . Spearfinger!

cherokee: ᏍᎩᎾ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᎦᏰᏌᏗ ᏙᏳᏕᎦ ᎤᎶᏒᏍᏗ ᎤᏲᎢ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᏍᎩᎵ ᏤᎮᎢ ᎦᎸᎳᏗᏳ ᎦᏚᏏ.
english: Spearfinger was a terrible old monster who lived high in the mountains.

cherokee: ᎾᎩᎾᏃ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏥᎦᏰᏌᏕ ᏃᎴ ᎦᏅᎯᏓ ᏗᏓᏰᎳᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᏃᎴ ᎦᏁᎦᏗᏓᎸᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏣᏄᏍᏕ.
english: She had a sharp finger as long as a dagger and shaped like an awl.

cherokee: ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᏥᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏗ ᎠᏓᏪᎯ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᏃᎴ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏧᏲᏏᏍᎨᎢ.
english: Spearfinger had magic powers and she was always hungry.

cherokee: ᏙᏳ ᎣᎯᏍᏗᏳ ᏧᏪᎳ ᏧᎸᏉᏗ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ ᏚᏂᎸᎢ!
english: What she liked best was to eat the livers of Cherokee children!

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎾᎨᎢ ᏤᏙᎵᏙᎮᎢ ᎢᎪᎯᏓ ᏃᎴ ᎢᏳᏊ ᎱᏚᎵᏍᎬᎢ ᏣᎳᏍᏕᎵᏴᏍᎨᎢ.
english: She roamed through the forests and any time she wanted to she could shapeshift.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎭᎳᏍᏕᎵᏴᏌ ᏍᎩᎵ ᏃᏗ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᏣᎦᎾᏅᎪᎨᎢ.
english: She could change her appearance from looking like a monster to looking like an old woman.

cherokee: ᎢᎤᏍᏗᏯᏛᎾ ᏳᎳᏍᏕᎵᏴᏌ ᏗᎧᎾᏗ ᎠᏎᏃ ᏅᏱ ᎠᏍᏓᏱ ᏥᎨᏎᎢ ᎱᏁᎦᎸᎢ ᏃᎴ ᎨᏍᏓᏗ ᎦᏟᏓ ᎬᏔᎸᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
english: No matter how she looked her skin was hard like a rock and arrows would not pierce it.

cherokee: ᎯᎳᏳᎢ ᏳᏢᏂ ᎠᏲᏟ, ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏛ ᏥᏕᎦᏘᏍᏗᏍᎨ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎦᏂᎯᏓ ᎦᏁᎦᏗᏓᎸᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏛᎢ ᏃᎴ ᏧᏪᎳ ᏣᏕᎦᎵᎩᎡᎮᎢ.
english: When the child fell asleep, Spearfinger would stab her with the long awl finger and take out her liver.

cherokee: ᏃᏗ ᎤᎵᎪᎲᏍᏗ ᏱᎩ ᏧᎧᏎᏍᏕ ᏧᎦᏒᏍᏗ ᎤᎳᏌᎳᏙᏗ ᏕᏍᎬᎢ ᎦᎸᎾᏗᏣ.
english: In the Fall Spearfinger would watch for the smoke to rise above the trees.

cherokee: ᎯᎳᏳᎢ ᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᏱᏄᎳᏍᏓᎾ, ᏍᎩᎾ. ᏣᎧᏔᎮ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᏧᏆᎶᎩ ᏓᎾᎪᎰᏍᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎣᎴ ᏘᎵ ᎭᏂᎳᎨᏴᎢ ᎡᎳᏗ.
english: When that happened, she knew the Cherokees were burning the leaves to get the chestnuts on the ground.

cherokee: ᏂᎠ ᎤᏁᎩᎸᏗ-ᎠᎦᏴᎵ ᏧᎸᏆᏕ ᎤᎧᎯᏓ ᏃᎴ ᎤᎦᏒᏍᏗ.
english: The old hag loved fog and smoke.

cherokee: ᎠᎯᏓ ᏄᎳᏍᏓᏁᎮ ᎤᏗᏍᎦᎳᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏓᎾᎢᏍᏙᏗ ᏐᎢ ᎤᏐᏅᏅᏍᏙᏗ.
english: It made it easier to stay hidden until she was ready to strike her next victim.

cherokee: ᎨᏍᏓᏗ ᏂᎦᎾ ᏰᎬᏁ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᏃᎴ ᏣᎾᏁᎳᏗᏍᎨ ᎠᏂᏔᎵᎭ ᏧᎾᎵᎪᏗ ᎠᎴ ᎤᎵᎢᎦᎢ ᎱᎾᏓᏍᎬᎢ ᎤᏁᏓᏍᏗ.
english: The Cherokees were never safe and tried to always stay together in groups of 2 or more.

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᎭᏫᏂᏳ ᏧᎾᏍᎪᏎ ᏗᎦᎾᏗᏫᏒᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎦᏅᏅ ᏃᎴ ᏧᏅᏒᏁᎢ ᏧᏩᏂᎦᏢ ᎬᏗ.
english: The Cherokees dug a deep pit across the trail and covered it with branches.

cherokee: ᏃᏊᏗ ᎡᏆ ᏧᏃᏔᏁᎢ ᎾᎥᏂ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎦᏅᏅ ᏃᎴ ᏧᎾᏗᏍᎦᎳᏁ ᏌᎷᏱ.
english: Then they built a large fire near the trail and hid in the laurels.

cherokee: ᏃᏉᏗᏍᏉ ᏣᏂᎧᏔᎮ ᎢᏳᏊ ᏓᎦᎷᏥᏒ ᏍᎩᎾ. ᎭᎪᏘᏍᎬᎢ ᏧᎧᏒᏍᏗ.
english: They knew she would come as soon as she saw the smoke.

cherokee: ᎾᎥ ᎾᎢ ᎠᎦᏳᎵᎨ ᎤᎷᏨᎩ ᏧᏓᏅᏠᎯᏗ ᎨᎸᏛᏍᏗ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎦᏅᏅ.
english: By and by an old woman came hobbling along the trail.

cherokee: ᎦᏚᎱᎢ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏗᎾᏔᎾᎢ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎵ ᏣᏂᎧᏔᎮᎢ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏚᏓᏥᎶᏚ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎨᏍᏓᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎪᎱᏍᏓ ᏳᏛᎾ ᎱᎾᏓᏓᏰᏙᏗᏍᎬ ᏍᎩᎾ.
english: When she stepped onto the pitfall and tumbled through the branches into the hole she turned back into Spearfinger.

cherokee: ᎯᎳᏳᎢ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏩᏚᎳᏏᏁ ᎦᏚᎢ ᎭᏫᎾ ᏗᏔᎳᎧᏒᎢ ᏣᏭᎶᎢᏎᎢ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏗ ᏣᎾᎤᎳᏍᏓᏁ ᎱᎳᏍᏕᎵᏴᏌ.
english: She screamed and clawed at the sides of the pit with her sharp awl finger.

cherokee: ᏍᎩᎾᏃ ᏧᏪᎷᏁ ᏃᎴ ᏚᏩᏯᏑᎦᎸ ᎾᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᏔᎸᎦᏒ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᎦᏁᎦᏗᏓᎸᎦᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏗ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏣᏚᏩᏘᎴ ᏂᎬᏛᎢ ᎠᏁᎳᏗᏍᎬ ᏧᏩᏘᏍᏗ ᎢᏳᏍᏓᏊ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎥ ᎾᎢ ᏳᎷᏥ ᎦᎸᏗᏣ ᎦᏙ ᎠᏔᎸᎦᏒᎢ.
english: She jabbed around in every direction trying to stab anyone who came near the top of the pitfall.

cherokee: ᏂᎦᏓᏃ ᏣᏂᎧᏔᎮᎢ ᎠᏓᏪᎯ ᎨᏒ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏗ ᎨᏒ ᏃᎴ ᎢᏳᏊ ᏗᏁᎳᏔᏂᏒᎢ ᎤᏅᎪᎢᏍᏗ ᎭᎾ ᎠᏔᎸᎧᏒᎢ.
english: Everyone knew Spearfinger was magic and would soon figure out a way to get out of the pitfall.
But, along came a little bird, a titmouse.

cherokee: ᏃᏉᏗ ᏙᏳ ᏧᏂᎾᎸᏤ ᎭᎾᏉ ᏧᏂᏂᏴᎮ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏥᏍᏆ ᏃᎴ ᏧᎾᏣᎧᏎᎴ ᎦᎾᎪᎢ.
english: They were so angry they caught the bird and cut off its tongue.

cherokee: ᎯᎪᎢᎦ ᎯᎠ ᏥᏍᏆ ᎦᏯᎪᎦ ᏍᏆᎳ ᎦᎾᎪᎢ ᏃᎴ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᎭᏂᎧᏔ ᎦᏯᎪᎦ ᎨᏒᎢ.
english: Even today the titmouse has a short tongue and Cherokee people know it is a liar.

cherokee: ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏃ ᏄᏓᎴ ᎤᏍᏗ ᏥᏍᏆ, ᏥᎩᎵ, ᎱᏃᎯᎵᏣᏁ ᎡᎳᏗ ᎨᏒᎢ ᎯᎠ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏩᏂᎦᎸᎢ ᏃᎴ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏍᎩᎵ ᎦᏃᎨᎾ.
english: Soon another little bird, a chickadee, flew down from the high branches and lighted on the witch’s right hand.

cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏃᏟᏙᎯ ᏧᏂᎪᎮᎢ ᏃᎴ ᏣᏂᎧᏔᎮᎢ ᎢᏳᏃ ᎢᏣ ᎤᎾᎳᏐᏍᏙᏗ.
english: The warriors saw this and knew it was a sign to aim there.

cherokee: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏥᎩᎵᎵ ᏣᎧᏔᎮᎢ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏍᏛᎢ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎤᏓᎾᏛᎢ ᎨᏍᏓᏗ ᎦᏁᏥ ᏯᏄᏍᏕᎢ.
english: The chickadee knew Spearfinger’s secret – that her heart was not in her chest.

cherokee: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏆᎾᎥᎢ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᏍᎩᏴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏃᏟᏙᎯ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏂᏲᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏐᏅᎢ ᏍᎩᎵ.
english: It was in the soft palm of her hand. At last the hunters could destroy the evil witch.

cherokee: ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏟᏓ ᎤᏪᏘᎸᎩ ᏆᎾᎥᎢ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᏃᎴ ᏍᎩᏴᏃ ᏧᎵᏬᏤᎢ.
english: An arrow struck her palm and she was dead.
